-- class: contract
-- name: seed-counter

-- class: contract
-- kind: add-column-required
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."docs" add column "n" bigint not null;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."okm_ctr_doc_no" (
  "tenantId" uuid not null,
  "period" text not null,
  "n" bigint not null,
  primary key ("tenantId", "period")
);

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke all on table "public"."okm_ctr_doc_no" from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: replace-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create or replace function "public"."okm_next_doc_no"(p0 uuid, p_period text) returns bigint
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = pg_catalog, public
as $okm$
declare
  issued bigint;
begin
  -- okm-series {"series":{"name":"doc_no","as":"bigint","start":"1","increment":"1","counter":true,"scope":[{"name":"tenantId","type":"uuid"}]},"table":"docs","column":"n","counter":"okm_ctr_doc_no","next":"okm_next_doc_no","assign":"okm_assign_doc_no_n","index":"okm_uq_doc_no_n"}
  insert into "public"."okm_ctr_doc_no" ("tenantId", "period", "n")
  values (p0, p_period, 1)
  on conflict ("tenantId", "period") do update set "n" = "okm_ctr_doc_no"."n" + 1
  returning "n" into issued;
  if issued > 9223372036854775807 or issued < 1 then raise exception 'series % is outside % .. %', 'doc_no', 1, 9223372036854775807; end if;
  return issued;
end
$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: replace-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create or replace function "public"."okm_assign_doc_no_n"() returns trigger
language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = pg_catalog, public
as $okm$
begin
  -- okm-series {"series":{"name":"doc_no","as":"bigint","start":"1","increment":"1","counter":true,"scope":[{"name":"tenantId","type":"uuid"}]},"table":"docs","column":"n","counter":"okm_ctr_doc_no","next":"okm_next_doc_no","assign":"okm_assign_doc_no_n","index":"okm_uq_doc_no_n"}
  if TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and OLD."n" is not null and (NEW."tenantId" is distinct from OLD."tenantId") then raise exception 'series % refuses a change of scope or the reset column after a number is assigned', 'doc_no'; end if;
  if NEW."n" is null then
    
    NEW."n" := "public"."okm_next_doc_no"(NEW."tenantId", '');
    
  end if;
  return NEW;
end
$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE
create trigger "okm_assign_doc_no_n" before insert or update on "public"."docs" for each row execute function "public"."okm_assign_doc_no_n"();

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create unique index "okm_uq_doc_no_n" on "public"."docs" ("tenantId", "n");

-- class: expand
-- kind: seed-counter
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ROW SHARE
insert into "public"."okm_ctr_doc_no" ("tenantId", "period", "n") select "tenantId", '', max("n") from "public"."docs" where "n" is not null group by "tenantId", '' on conflict ("tenantId", "period") do update set "n" = greatest("okm_ctr_doc_no"."n", excluded."n");
